SELECT subscription_plan_id, duration_months, monthly_unit_price FROM subscription_plan WHERE plan_code = 'PLAN_YEARLY' AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert:
SELECT SQ_PAYMENT_ORDER.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO payment_order (payment_order_id, company_id, external_order_no, buyer_account_id, subscription_plan_id, purpose_code, seat_count, monthly_unit_price, discount_rate, total_amount, priced_at) VALUES (#{paymentOrderId}, #{companyId}, #{externalOrderNo}, #{buyerAccountId}, #{subscriptionPlanId}, #{purposeCode}, #{seatCount}, #{monthlyUnitPrice}, #{discountRate}, #{totalAmount}, #{pricedAt})
mapper.sql: SELECT o.payment_order_id, o.company_id, o.external_order_no, o.buyer_account_id, o.subscription_plan_id, o.purpose_code, o.status_code, o.seat_count, o.monthly_unit_price, o.discount_rate, o.total_amount, o.priced_at, p.duration_months FROM payment_order o JOIN subscription_plan p ON p.subscription_plan_id = o.subscription_plan_id
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_order SET status_code = 'ORD_FAILED', updated_at = CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP) WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status_code = 'ORD_CREATED'

UPDATE payment_order SET status_code = 'ORD_APPLIED', applied_at = #{appliedAt}, updated_at = CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP) WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND payment_order_id = #{orderId} AND status_code = 'ORD_CONFIRMED'
mapper.insert:
SELECT SQ_PAYMENT.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO payment (payment_id, company_id, payment_order_id, payment_key, idempotency_key, status_code, approved_amount, approved_at) VALUES (#{paymentId}, #{companyId}, #{paymentOrderId}, #{paymentKey}, #{idempotencyKey}, 'PAY_APPROVED', #{approvedAmount}, #{approvedAt})

SELECT SQ_PAYMENT.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO payment (payment_id, company_id, payment_order_id, idempotency_key, status_code, failure_code, failure_message) VALUES (#{paymentId}, #{companyId}, #{paymentOrderId}, #{idempotencyKey}, 'PAY_FAILED', #{failureCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{failureMessage, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

INSERT INTO subscription_change (company_id, payment_id, payment_order_id, service_period_id, change_type, before_seats, after_seats, before_ends_at, after_ends_at, applied_at) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{paymentId}, #{paymentOrderId}, #{servicePeriodId}, #{changeType}, #{beforeSeats, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{afterSeats}, #{beforeEndsAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{afterEndsAt}, #{appliedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT o.external_order_no AS order_no, CASE WHEN o.purpose_code = 'PP_FIRST' THEN 'FIRST' ELSE 'EXTEND' END AS kind, CASE WHEN pl.plan_code = 'PLAN_YEARLY' THEN 'ANNUAL' ELSE 'MONTHLY' END AS plan, pl.duration_months, o.seat_count, o.total_amount, o.discount_rate, CASE WHEN p.status_code = 'PAY_APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS approved, NVL(p.approved_at, p.created_at) AS paid_at, sp.starts_at, sp.ends_at, p.failure_message AS reason FROM payment p JOIN payment_order o ON o.company_id = p.company_id AND o.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id JOIN subscription_plan pl ON pl.subscription_plan_id = o.subscription_plan_id LEFT JOIN service_period sp ON sp.company_id = o.company_id AND sp.source_order_id = o.payment_order_id WHERE p.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.payment_id DESC
